title: Preservation of leading ones
statement: Let $q$ be a transducer state such that reading a $1$ leaves the state unchanged and outputs $1$. For every natural number $k$ and finite bit string $r$, processing $k$ consecutive $1$s followed by $r$ from state $q$ preserves those $k$ leading $1$s and then processes $r$ from $q$.
hypotheses_covered: Reading $1$ from $q$ leaves the state unchanged
